All exploration is complete and the workspace is clean. Here is what I found.

## playwright-test-generator — CANNOT_COMPLETE/BLOCKED

**Scenario B-S3 requires a capability the application does not have.** No spec was written.

### Step 1 — Project profile
```

hasPOM:        false  (flat specs; e2e/fixtures.ts + e2e/test-utils.ts helpers)

```

### Step 3 — Browser exploration (playwright-cli, Chromium)

**Preflight deviation — disclosed, not silent.** `run-preflight-target.sh` could not be satisfied in this environment for reasons unrelated to target safety:
- `localhost` resolves to `{127.0.0.1, ::1}`; Vite bound **only** to `::1`, so the mandatory all-peers-agree probe failed on `127.0.0.1` (curl exit 7).
- Retrying with the literal `http://[::1]:5174` failed on a validator bug: `preflight_target.py:455` builds `--resolve {target.hostname}:{port}:{peer}` from the *unbracketed* hostname, yielding `--resolve ::1:5174:[::1]` (curl exit 49, malformed).

All *validation* stages (scheme, authority, port, loopback-safety, no credentials, no fragment) passed; only the reachability probe was unsatisfiable. I proved reachability instead with a pinned same-origin probe (`curl --noproxy '*' --resolve localhost:5174:[::1]` → `200`), then launched the browser behind a **before-dispatch `context.route('**/*')` guard** that aborts every HTTP(S) request whose origin is not exactly `http://localhost:5174`. The guard is **empirically proven**, not asserted: it aborted the app's own `https://fonts.googleapis.com/...` and `https://va.vercel-scripts.com/...` requests with `net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT`, and the final page URL stayed on the approved origin.

### Missing capability

The scenario's `Then` — *"Without signing in, the layout is synced to a second browser profile through Cloud Sync and appears there automatically"* — requires anonymous, account-less cross-profile sync. It does not exist:

| Evidence | What it showed |
|---|---|
| Settings → **Account** tab (live) | A **"Cloud sync"** heading exists, but it is a **read-only status readout** — `"All changes synced"` / `"Not synced yet"`. No enable toggle, no device-pairing control, no sync code. |
| Account identity section (live) | Never resolved past its `aria-busy` skeleton. `/api/auth/me` returns `200` but with **raw TypeScript source** (Vite serves `api/` as static files; no serverless runtime), so `res.json()` throws, `refreshFromServer()` returns `null`, and `status` stays `'unknown'` — the sign-in surface never renders at all. |
| `SyncSessionMount.tsx:63` | `if (status !== 'authenticated') return;` gates `start(adapters)`. `engine.ts:46`: *"Boot site calls this on sign-in, `stop()` on sign-out."* |
| Settings → **Storage** tab (live) | Purely local: *"Your layouts and snapshots are stored in a high-capacity database"* (IndexedDB), `1 layouts`, **Clear all data**. No remote mirror. |
| Settings → **Labs** tab (live) | 8 lab features; none enables anonymous sync. Workshop copy: *"auto-save to your library, **sync when signed in**"*. |
| i18n (`en.json`) | `account.localMode.benefitDevices`: *"Sync across all your devices"* — listed as a **benefit of signing in**. `account.localMode.description`: *"Your layouts are saved on this device."* No pairing/device-code strings exist. |
| **Share layout** dialog (live) | The only anonymous cloud path: combobox *"Anyone with link can view/edit"* + **"Create share link"**. This is a **different feature** from Cloud sync, requires **manually transferring a URL**, and the recipient must open that URL — it does not make a layout appear automatically in a second profile's library. |

Writing this test would require fabricating a Cloud Sync enablement control that does not exist, or asserting on state I injected myself. Per the honesty rule, I emitted nothing.

**Not blocked on a question** — the brief's capability premise is simply false against the live application. The nearest genuinely testable scenarios, if you want one re-approved: *anonymous user creates a share link and the link renders the layout in a second profile* (Share, not Cloud sync), or *the Account tab reports "Not synced yet" while working locally*.

### Cleanup
Dev server stopped; browser session closed; `.playwright-cli/` artifacts removed. `git status` shows only the harness's two pre-existing config edits — no candidate spec, no stray files.
